raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
US Healthcare Technical Lead, Business Analyst and Certified Scrum Master with 12 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale digital and solutions across Payer and Provider domains. Expert in Product Lifecycle Management, Agile/ Scrum leadership, Business Analysis, Claim Adjudication, Claims, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Proven ability to align business strategy with technology execution, lead cross-functional Agile teams, and deliver high-impact healthcare products. Certified CSM with strong stakeholder management and delivery excellence. Focused on team collaboration, adapting to changing needs, backlog management and delivering tangible results. Known for clear communication, strategic planning, and problem-solving abilities.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK HISTORY
EMIDS TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD
January 2024 - April 2026 Healthmine Member Engagement Phase 2 - Business Analyst, Bengaluru, India
Project Areas:
Personalized, Omnichannel outreach, rewards, gap closure and data analysis into one user-friendly engagement platform.
Key Contributions:
• Collaborated with cross‑functional teams (product, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders) to translate business problems into data-driven analytical requirements and insights.
• Designed, maintained, and prioritized analytical backlogs including data requests, dashboards, reports, and ad‑hoc analyses aligned with business objectives.
• Analyzed structured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and
anomalies, supporting sprint goals, product improvements, and operational decision-making.
Broke down complex business questions into actionable analytical
tasks, defining data sources, transformations, and calculation logic for accurate analysis.
Partnered with development and QA teams to test data pipelines, reports, and dashboards, ensuring metrics were consistent with business definitions.
April 2021 - December 2023 Greenway ClearingHouse Services - Business Analyst, Bengaluru, India
As a Business Analyst, worked with multiple scrum teams on Clearing House Services, gaining good exposure to different EDI formats such as 837P, 837I, 837, Claim Adjudication, and other messages like 277CA, 834, 835, TA1, 999, and 820.
Key Contributions:
Gathered and documented functional requirements (URS and FRS) and
created User Stories based on the features.
Utilized systematic techniques like use-case scenarios, process modeling, and data-flow diagramming to ensure comprehensive requirements, considering product feasibility and market needs.
Conducted walk-through sessions, maintained stakeholder alignment, and delivered consistent demos to onshore leadership.
Eliciting business needs, analyzing EDI workflows, and mapping data fields between internal systems and standard EDI formats.
Planning and executing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring data accuracy and compliance with standards like ANSI X12.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure the system design aligned with business objectives and user needs.
Coordinated with the UX design team to create product design and ensured user-centric design decisions.
Utilizing JIRA for project management and tracking and contributing to strategic planning initiatives
Developed business process models to identify and document customer requirements.
October 2015 - March 2021 Greenway ClearingHouse Services - Senior Test Engineer, Bengaluru, India Project Areas: • Portal and Processing to determine real-time visibility throughout the life-cycle of each claim. Key Contributions:
Analyzing the business requirement document and authoring test cases • Executed Test cases for smoke, Component, Integration, System and Compatibility Testing in QC
Expertise in executing regression test cases and impact analysis. • Participated in reviewing test cases.
Prepared RTM to ensure requirement coverage.
• Active participation in Daily Scrum meetings and other sprint ceremonies.
• Provided technical support during and after the implementation of healthcare electronic data interchange applications.
• Responded to inquiries regarding EDI issues with encounter claims and trading partner activities.
Managed catalog of EDI document types such as 837, 277CA, 834, 835, TA1, 999, 820.
Maintained detailed documentation and process flow of all EDI processes.
Conducted comprehensive testing of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions to ensure compliance with industry standards and business requirements.
Developed and executed detailed test plans and test cases for various EDI document types, including 837, 277CA, 834, 835, TA1, 999, 820.
March 2014 - September 2015 Active Health Management (AHM-IT) - Associate Test Engineer, Bangalore Project Areas: Aetna population health management suite, covering Provider, Nurse, and Patient portals along with back-end components Key Contributions:
Authored test cases in Gherkin (BDD) format, enabling clear alignment between business requirements and automated acceptance criteria.
Executed end-to-end Manual, Integration, and Regression test cycles across Agile sprints covering ESB, Data Mart, Care Engine, and all portals.
Drove 2 successful production checkouts for major Aetna feature initiatives, ensuring zero critical defects at release.
